from api import list_items_response


def test_list_items_response_returns_items():
    result = list_items_response({})
    assert [item["id"] for item in result["items"]] == [1, 2, 3, 4]


def test_list_items_response_paginates():
    result = list_items_response({"limit": "2", "offset": "1"})
    assert [item["id"] for item in result["items"]] == [2, 3]
    assert result["next_offset"] == 3

from api import list_items_response


def test_pagination_keeps_items_and_advances_only_when_needed():
    first = list_items_response({"limit": "2", "offset": "0"})
    assert [item["id"] for item in first["items"]] == [1, 2]
    assert first["next_offset"] == 2

    final = list_items_response({"limit": "2", "offset": "2"})
    assert [item["id"] for item in final["items"]] == [3, 4]
    assert final.get("next_offset") in (None, 4)
